intro: President Trump appointed Jay Clayton as White House AI czar, a former intelligence official who has previously characterized AI as both a transformative technology and a security concern. Bitdefender launched AI Guardian, a security tool designed to evaluate and block potentially malicious actions by AI agents before execution. Google suspended its open-source bug bounty program after experiencing a significant surge in low-quality submissions generated by AI systems.
